wiki:pamela-jeanine-p-moses.name: Pamela Jeanine "P." Moses
wiki:pamela-jeanine-p-moses.bio: Activist and musician who founded the Let It B Known Records label; former ex-officio District 7 Shelby County Democratic Executive Committee chairwoman.

positions.stance: Champions criminal justice reform that integrates economic opportunity, including workforce development programs for formerly incarcerated people to reduce recidivism.
Advocates universal healthcare access "ensuring every Tennessean receives quality medical care," including expanded mental health resources.
Plans to eliminate food deserts in Tennessee by supporting farmers' markets in underserved areas and promoting sustainable local agriculture.
Will push legislation expanding access to mental health services and developing youth mentorship and leadership programs.
Supports reducing carbon emissions through green energy and American-made infrastructure, including a high-speed rail line.

H6TN08342.name: Horace Taylor
H6TN08342.bio: Retired U.S. Army Major, cybersecurity professional and small-business owner.

positions.stance: "Trade policy should not be written on the backs of West Tennessee row-crop families"; supports bridge relief for producers hit by retaliatory tariffs.
"Your ZIP code should not decide whether you survive a diagnosis"; lists healthcare and rural hospitals as a top priority.
Says relief "has to be practical, measurable, and land inside the household budget."
Promises "advocacy on budget day, not just on Veterans Day" for veterans and service members.
"Train West Tennesseans for the jobs that are actually being built here."

H6IN02205.name: William Henry
H6IN02205.bio: U.S. Army and Indiana Army National Guard veteran (2005-2015) and former Department Adjutant of The American Legion, Department of Indiana.

positions.stance: Supports reducing taxes, reforming tax law, cutting federal agency budgets and personnel, and eliminating fraud, waste, and abuse.
Wants to grow and promote U.S. businesses and "reduce suppressive regulatory hurdles for businesses."
Supports a strong national defense and "Defend the Guard" legislation, and wants to reduce and end foreign conflicts and overseas contingency operations.
Supports expanding community healthcare programs for veterans and better integrating their records, billing, and coding.
Calls for regaining individual medical decisions, independent review of vaccine approval, and ending federal cannabis prohibition with expungement of federal cannabis records.
Says U.S. armed forces "should not be intruding in the Middle East" and calls to "return our troops home."
Says rolling back restrictive federal rules and regulations is what voters want.
Demands a balanced budget and would encourage moving to a sales tax or FAIR Tax model and eliminating the IRS.
Supports the MORE Act to legalize marijuana and expunging records for small amounts of personal possession.
Would endorse pro-climate bills "without increasing taxes on the American People."

H6IN09283.name: Floyd Taylor
H6IN09283.bio: IT and network systems professional for more than 25 years, cancer survivor, and local business owner in Southern Indiana.

positions.stance: Suggests "grow-in-place" tax credits for multi-year rural hires and using NSWC Crane to seed defense-tech spin-offs and small-business grants.
Proposes a public-private last-mile bond pool and workforce hubs alongside broadband pilots.
Proposes mobile telehealth vans offering primary care, mental health, and addiction recovery support, plus loan repayment for rural family-practice residencies.
Proposes a "9th District Tech Corps" of paid internships and employer-branded credentials through community colleges.
Suggests peer-mediator programs in middle schools and tele-forensic units for rural evidence analysis.

wiki:sam-husseini.name: Sam Husseini
wiki:sam-husseini.bio: Journalist with the Institute for Public Accuracy who previously worked at the American-Arab Anti-Discrimination Committee and the media watch group FAIR.

positions.stance: Calls to end U.S. military aggression and funding for Israel's wars, and to spend on infrastructure in Maryland instead.
Says schools "shouldn't resemble prisons or have a 'CEO'" and should "create an environment of inquiry and wonder."
Calls to rein in ICE and Flock surveillance cameras, which he says violate the Fourth Amendment.
Opposes data centers over electricity costs and pollution and demands "more than just a moratorium."
Supports Medicare for All and would vote to stop privatization of Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.

H0MO08285.name: Tom Schmitz
H0MO08285.bio: Criminal defense attorney from St. Louis.

positions.stance: Calls for "a foreign policy of peace and non-interventionism," ending the war with Iran, and ending all foreign aid.
Blames inflation on government money printing and wants to transition to "a free market, voluntary monetary system."
Supports "separation of healthcare and state," a free-market system free from government control.
Calls himself an "A.I. optimist" but believes there is a federal role in addressing A.I.'s risk of catastrophic harm.
Wants to end the war on drugs and legalize controlled substances, treating them "the same under the law as alcohol."

H2MO06269.name: Andy Maidment
H2MO06269.bio: Retired Army officer with 21 years in the Army and Missouri National Guard, and an IT security professional.

positions.stance: Would eliminate federal departments "which have no Constitutional basis," starting with Education, Commerce, and Homeland Security.
Wants to protect free speech and gun rights and "end the Surveillance State of the Patriot Act."
Says "taxation is theft" and opposes the income tax and Federal Reserve money printing.
"Bring our troops home" from the Middle East while maintaining a robust national defense and peaceful trade.
Says a significant part of the national debt comes from "foolishly spent money" and calls for accountability in Washington spending.
Committed to "promoting legislation to abolish all unconstitutional bureaucracies and federal programs."
Describes himself as a pacifist who believes "we should abolish tyranny by ballots rather than by bullets."
"Kevin Craig wants to cut a trillion dollars from federal spending."
Says he is committed to "never increasing taxes or spending."
Supports "online issue by issue voting" on the Voter Directed Network app: "One voter. One vote. On all issues."
Wants a political system "with no donors, no lobbyists, no Super PACs, and no political parties."
Says public office "is not a position of status" but "a responsibility to serve the Will of the voters."

H2WI03163.name: Rustin Provance
H2WI03163.bio: Trade-school graduate with an HVAC-R certificate and father of seven living in Wisconsin.

positions.stance: Says judges and prosecutors "need to be held accountable" and the Supreme Court needs term limits.
Wants Social Security made optional to enter and exit, or ended with sums paid out, and decided by public vote.
Will "fight to end the Federal Reserve" and its fiat currency, backing currency with tangible goods.
Wants to "remove federal control over healthcare, as it is an individual issue."
Says nuclear explosions "need to cease" and their long-term environmental effects should be studied by all nations.

wiki:arthur-burks.name: Arthur Burks
wiki:arthur-burks.bio: Milwaukee businessman who has served with the National Action Network.

positions.stance: Advocates livable wages, local business investment, and vocational training for youth.
Supports expanding community clinics and mental health facilities so every resident has affordable care.
Supports comprehensive gun safety legislation and funding for violence interruption programs.
Will push for federal funding to upgrade Milwaukee school infrastructure and resources for teachers.
Says "housing is a human right" and will fight for federal subsidies to expand Milwaukee's affordable housing.

H6WI06274.name: Matthew Arndt
H6WI06274.bio: CPA and business owner who runs a tax and investment advisory firm.

positions.stance: "Break up monopolies" to restore competition and bring down prices and inflation.
Supports Medicare for All, citing lower administrative overhead than private insurance.
Says "strong wages build strong communities" and supports strong labor laws.
"Stop forever wars," which he says are bankrupting the country.
"Cut ties with Israel. End all foreign entanglements."

H6WI06241.name: Elizabeth Fitzgibbon
H6WI06241.bio: Mother and advocate who took her own family law case to the U.S. Supreme Court.

positions.stance: Supports policies that strengthen competition, reduce price-gouging, and put consumers ahead of corporate special interests.
Protect Social Security and Medicare "so seniors can retire with dignity and financial security."
Wants to reduce health care and prescription drug costs through more transparency and competition.
Supports cutting unnecessary red tape for small businesses and family farms.
Supports practical solutions that expand housing supply to make housing more attainable.

H6WI06233.name: Michael Thurow
H6WI06233.bio: Union fire captain and HAZMAT team director who previously worked at Healthcare for the Homeless.

positions.stance: Supports stronger federal oversight of utilities, pharmaceuticals, and essential goods, and breaking up food supply-chain monopolies.
Wants to cut middle-class and small-business taxes by closing corporate loopholes, and expand the child tax credit.
Says Medicare should negotiate all drug prices and private equity should be blocked from taking over health care services.
Supports federal right-to-repair legislation for farm equipment, electronics, and cars.
Would ban "surveillance price setting" for individual consumers and push for stronger data protection laws.

H6CO01356.name: Shimon Blau
H6CO01356.bio: Board-certified physician and small business owner from Denver.

positions.stance: Health care "should be dependable and within reach for every family."
Says Denver families "deserve policies that ease the squeeze" on rent, groceries, and bills.
Wants to strengthen the environment for small businesses to grow, invest, and create good-paying jobs.
Supports better childcare options so parents can "show up for their kids and their jobs."
"Secure our borders while building a faster, more efficient legal immigration system."
"We deserve an America at peace."
"It's time for a flat tax and a one-page income tax return."
"We have executed innocent people. It is time to abolish the death penalty."
"The government must butt out of the abortion debate."
Supports decriminalizing drugs, which he says would "turn drug dealers into vendors."

H6MN05373.name: DeVelle Jackson
H6MN05373.bio: Former union roofer and carpenter who worked in Minnesota construction.

positions.stance: Will fight for a comprehensive federal privacy law that "makes privacy the default" and gives individuals control of their data.
Calls for ICE reform so agents are identifiable and due process is protected, and for Congress to reclaim war powers.
Supports an 18-year limit and an upper age limit for Congress, and 18-year limits for Supreme Court justices.
Supports a "Rich Tax" on billionaires and a federal Civic Service Credit for verified unpaid community service.
Supports stronger federal labor protections so workers can organize and bargain without retaliation.

wiki:margo-ellis.name: Margo Ellis
wiki:margo-ellis.bio: Marine Corps veteran, former investment bank vice president and Silicon Valley consultant, rideshare driver, and comedian.

positions.stance: Supports targeted tax incentives, streamlined regulation, and capital access for entrepreneurs in rural and underserved counties.
Would close loopholes letting large multinational corporations avoid taxes "so middle-class families don't shoulder the burden."
Protect and strengthen Social Security and Medicare so benefits keep pace with inflation.
Supports full funding and expedited claims for veterans, plus job training and mental health services.
Supports investing in teacher training and incentives to recruit and retain educators in underserved schools.
